title: The Night Owl
topic: ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว
lines: During my first year at university, I thought studying late at night
was the secret to success. I would start my homework at eleven and
finish at three or four in the morning. My roommate, Jin, went to bed
at ten every night. I laughed at **him** and called him "Grandpa."
By the middle of the term, however, things were going badly. I fell
asleep in morning classes, forgot deadlines and caught a cold that
lasted for weeks. Jin, on the other hand, was getting the best grades in
our class. One evening I asked him for his secret. "There is no
secret," he said. "I just study when my brain is awake." **This** made me
think. I tried his method for one month: no screens after ten and study
in the morning. It was hard at first, but my grades improved and I
